host_im2col: 3x3 valid, 16x16x4 input planes -> 196x36 INT8 matrix; timed by workload generator

quantization.activations: signed INT8; input round-to-nearest after multiplying by 127
quantization.logits: host global-average over 14x14 spatial positions then argmax
quantization.weights: signed INT8 symmetric round-to-nearest, per-layer max-abs scale
